title: The Identity Bird I
description: Define the Identity combinator I = lambda a: a and test it on values and on itself.

steps.description: Define the Identity bird I as lambda a: a, which returns whatever argument it receives.
Call I(42) and I('hello') to confirm both values pass through unchanged.

steps.question: What does I(I) return before it is applied to 42 on line 5?
steps.answer: Passing the function I into I returns the function I itself, which then evaluates I(42) to 42.

steps.description: Apply I to itself and then to 42 with I(I)(42), printing 42.
Step through I(I)(42) on line 5 to see I return itself first and then return 42.
